publication_scope: Owner-authorized functional, architecture and validation summaries only. No private code, product artwork, display binaries, private protocol definitions or raw device records.
environment: Linux host; no connected target hardware or official Windows HMI simulator

aerakia.full_stack: Private research engineering project; summarized functions include STM32H743 sensor integration, FreeRTOS, state estimation, HIL/SIL, replay and comparison tooling.
aerakia.historical_issue: Host timestamps restarted while MCU state persisted. Timestamp rollback produced an abnormally large integration step; target-side rollback detection and abnormal time-step protection were added. This is a historical fix summary, not a hardware retest.
aerakia.limitations: No new full-firmware build, target-board HIL, Ethernet bring-up or flight test performed for this preview. No certified flight-safety or reliability claim. Public algorithm replay is a distinct validation scope.

firmware_host_core.scope: Native C core regression, not board firmware execution

service_tool.scope: Host-side application tests; default assembly profile uses a simulator and rejects serial before opening a port

hmi_offline.skip_reason: Official-loop test requires Windows and vendor tools; not run here

lifhalo.limitations: Current RBT6 application has not been flashed or board-tested. Heating remains disabled. Load, timing, temperature-rise, official HMI editor/simulator and physical-screen acceptance are not established by these software results.
